points.title: 巴塞尔学习时期
points.description: 丹尼尔·伯努利在巴塞尔大学学习，师从约翰·伯努利。他在这里开始对数学和物理产生兴趣，并发表了多篇论文。这一时期对他后来的科学贡献奠定了基础。
points.descriptionEn: Daniel Bernoulli studied at the University of Basel, where he was taught by his brother Johann Bernoulli. He began to develop an interest in mathematics and physics here, publishing several papers that laid the foundation for his later scientific contributions.

points.title: 圣彼得堡科学院工作
points.titleEn: Work at the St. Petersburg Academy
points.description: 伯努利在圣彼得堡科学院工作，期间他发表了关于流体力学和概率论的重要论文。他的工作对后来的科学界产生了深远的影响，特别是在统计学和流体动力学领域。
points.descriptionEn: Bernoulli worked at the St. Petersburg Academy, where he published significant papers on fluid mechanics and probability theory. His work had a profound impact on the scientific community, particularly in the fields of statistics and fluid dynamics.

points.title: 汉堡大学教授
points.titleEn: Professor at the University of Hamburg
points.description: 伯努利在汉堡大学担任教授，期间他继续在数学和物理学领域进行研究，发表了关于微分方程和天体力学的重要论文。他的工作对科学方法论的发展产生了重要影响。
points.descriptionEn: Bernoulli served as a professor at the University of Hamburg, where he continued his research in mathematics and physics, publishing important papers on differential equations and celestial mechanics. His work had a significant impact on the development of scientific methodology.

supporter.zh: 丹尼尔·伯努利是一位杰出的数学家和物理学家，他的工作对现代科学的发展产生了深远的影响。他被认为是概率论和流体动力学的奠基人之一，他的贡献在数学和物理学领域被广泛认可。
supporter.en: Daniel Bernoulli was an outstanding mathematician and physicist whose work had a profound impact on the development of modern science. He is considered one of the founders of probability theory and fluid dynamics, and his contributions are widely recognized in the fields of mathematics and physics.

critic.zh: 尽管伯努利的贡献巨大，但他的某些理论和方法在后来的发展中受到了挑战。一些批评者认为，他的某些假设过于简化，可能限制了其理论的适用性。
critic.en: Although Bernoulli's contributions were significant, some of his theories and methods have been challenged in later developments. Critics argue that some of his assumptions were overly simplistic, potentially limiting the applicability of his theories.

objective.zh: 在历史学界，丹尼尔·伯努利被视为科学革命的先驱之一，他的工作不仅推动了数学和物理学的发展，也促进了科学方法论的形成。在大众文化中，他通常被描绘为一位伟大的科学家，他的名字与许多科学发现和理论紧密相连。
objective.en: In the history of science, Daniel Bernoulli is regarded as one of the pioneers of the Scientific Revolution. His work not only advanced the fields of mathematics and physics but also contributed to the formation of scientific methodology. In popular culture, he is often portrayed as a great scientist, with his name closely associated with many scientific discoveries and theories.

self.zh: 自然界的规律是数学的，数学是自然界的语言。
self.en: The laws of nature are mathematical; mathematics is the language of nature.

others.zh: 伯努利是数学史上最伟大的数学家之一，他的工作对整个科学界都产生了深远的影响。
others.en: Bernoulli is one of the greatest mathematicians in the history of mathematics, and his work has had a profound impact on the entire scientific community.
